answer: Every identity stores one unique 40 GB violet shard, plus a mirror copy of each shard registered before it, so clone n carries n x 40 GB and 100 clones must hold 202,000 GB at $0.20 per GB, $40,400 a month, against $800 for 100 honest agents. Each epoch every agent signs a pulse proving it still holds its shards, and 3 rotating shard auditors then demand a random violet shard from an agent and its mirror twin within 90 seconds. One miss voids the shard, burns the $50 bond, and zeroes both weights for 10 epochs, the way a library locks the whole shelf over one missing book.
